review_improvement: Adds an explicit self-disconnection gate and identity-safe reconnection to OOB DCMI configuration.
independent_technical_reasoning: An OOB DHCP change can remove the endpoint mid-transaction. Valid coverage therefore requires an independent path, bounded rediscovery tied to immutable BMC identity, readback and rollback rather than blind retries.
